description: A bare null key names an object type attribute null
notes: The README requires attribute names to be valid identifiers, which null is, and builds the extension on hcl.ExprAsKeyword and hcl.ExprCall. The native syntax spec makes a keyword's role supersede other readings, where null would be the null value, but also says null can be interpreted as a static traversal named null (hclsyntax/spec.md#static-traversal), while hcl.ExprAsKeyword's own documentation (traversal_for_expr.go) says the native syntax parses true, false and null as literal values, so they can't be keywords. hashicorp/hcl names the attribute null: LiteralValueExpr.AsTraversal turns the null literal back into its name (hclsyntax/expression.go).
